transcript.answer: I could not find one definitive current location, so this is partly inferred. The knowledge base shows the footer composed in different places over time. (1) Early design: `prFooter({issueNumber, taskId})` in `agent/src/lib/pr-body.ts` always emits `Lore-Task: <uuid>` and prefixes `Refs #N` when an issue exists (spec 6-dark-factory, T047). (2) Later implementation-loop: the footer is built in the Floor-side pure helpers in `apps/floor/src/work/assembly-run/spec-pr.ts`. `stampLinePr` puts it on the draft, and `readyPrBody` (prose plus footer) recomposes it when the PR is marked ready (PR #1750). (3) Current stations: `apps/stations/src/implementation-loop/open-pr/station.ts` adds the `Closes`/`Lore-Task` footer to the draft. `draft-body.ts` in that folder composes only the body, and the footer stays the caller's. The `mark-ready` station recomposes the body with the footer. The onboard pipeline's `apps/stations/src/onboard/open-pr/` also adds a `Lore-Task` footer. I did not see the code itself, so I can't confirm which of these is the live footer-composing function today.

judgements.reason: The answer names prFooter() but places it in agent/src/lib/pr-body.ts rather than libs/shared/src/domain/pr-body.ts, and hedges among several other candidate locations without committing to the correct one.
